u0e9286c455: Users often change the following 3 items:
u7c31ba7952: Minimum searchable signal strength (可搜索最小信号强度): adjusts the distance within which devices are searched for; the smaller the number, the wider the range.
ufbcd25acd1: You can also set the name of the devices under test so that the test box connects only to them, making testing as fast as possible;
uf14e9f39b7: Change the maximum test power (测试最大功率): some devices connect more easily with a lower power.
ued2daddf27: 1. Host MAC address (主机MAC地址): the Bluetooth address of this test box
u3141a358b5: 2. Target MAC address (目标MAC地址): in fixed-address connection mode, the address of the Bluetooth device under test
ue6db25ac8a: 3. Upgrade battery threshold (升级电量门限): the device is not upgraded if its battery level is below the set percentage
u5533016229: 4. Fixed address connection enable (固定地址连接使能): when enabled, Bluetooth connects using a fixed address
u3bcafd0061: 5. Fixed device name connection enable (固定设备名连接使能): when enabled, Bluetooth connects using a fixed name
u3d9de56dec: 6. Match target device name prefix only (目标设备名仅匹配前缀): when enabled, Bluetooth devices whose names have the same prefix but different suffixes are matched
u53af614a01: 7. Automatic frequency offset correction enable (频偏自动校正使能): after the frequency offset is tested, the frequency offset of the target device is adjusted automatically
u65d5154b29: 8. Maximum search power (搜索最大功率) setting
ue1b87e3b6f: 9. Maximum search sensitivity (搜索最大灵敏度) setting
u8f339298bb: 10. Minimum searchable signal strength (可搜索最小信号强度), in db: controls the distance within which nearby devices are searched for
uef566ba3ee: 11. Maximum test power (测试最大功率) setting
u9d313cee7a: 12. Maximum frequency offset alert (最大频偏提醒): if the frequency offset of the tested device is greater than this value, the test box speaker sounds an alarm
udd206a521d: 13. Frequency correction (频率校正): the correction range. For example, if it is set to 10, the correction is complete when the frequency offset has been corrected to within -10k to +10k
u7eb29b833c: If it is not within this range, a prompt tone alerts you
u818ad9fb7d: 14. Channel 1 frequency offset (通道1频偏): the test box itself has a frequency offset, which must be entered here manually. For example, if channel 1 has a frequency offset of +2, enter 2 here; if it is -2, enter -2
u4c2e621598: 15. Channel 2 frequency offset (通道2频偏): the test box itself has a frequency offset, which must be entered here manually. For example, if channel 2 has a frequency offset of +2, enter 2 here; if it is -2, enter -2
u2a810502c6: Configuring a fixed device name for wireless connection
uc86adc5973: Version V1.2.5.b and later add the "Match target device name prefix only" (目标设备名仅匹配前缀) option
ued1fa11f4e: This supports a different device name suffix for each device under test (for example, when the suffix consists of some characters of the MAC address)
u8563c81696: Test time settings (normally no need to change)
u4f848b7daa: A2DP playback time (A2DP播放时间): the duration of the advanced audio test. For example, if it is set to 5s, the box moves on to the next test mode 5s after advanced audio playback starts, ending the advanced audio test (range 0-255s; 0: switch manually)
uc98952d82e: Dialing ringtone time (拨号铃声时间):
u5054cccd4f: During the call test, this is the simulated phone dialing time; when the set time expires, dialing ends and the call is simulated as connected (range 0-255s; 0: no dialing)
u2213c391e3: During the call test, this is the time for which the test box sends call test audio to the Bluetooth device; it then stops sending audio and starts the MIC test (range 0-255s; 0: no audio is sent and the MIC is tested directly)
u319141603e: During the call test, this is the MIC test duration; when the time expires, the MIC test ends (range 0-255s; 0: the MIC test does not end automatically and you must switch manually).
u45d2243b0b: Enabling the Bluetooth connection prompt tone
u39d6f06876: When this option is 1, prompt tones are enabled: the test box plays the "connected" prompt tone when the Bluetooth connection succeeds and the "disconnected" prompt tone when Bluetooth disconnects. (The loaded default configuration is 1.)
u0abc655f94: When this option is 0, no prompt tone is played on connection or disconnection.
u2a1455f662: Enabling test item switching with the PP button
u7cb8918ad2: This option takes effect when the test box is connected to the target device for a classic Bluetooth test. Versions before V122 do not have this option. It is enabled by default.
uc08615b315: When set to 1, pressing the PP button on the target device switches the test item (for example, from music playback to call, and from call to disconnect).
uc2364bd5da: When set to 0, pressing the PP button on the target device during the music playback test only pauses and resumes playback and does not switch to the next test item. To switch to the next test item, press the corresponding button on the test box.
u2b177577b6: Switch for TWS connection support in classic Bluetooth tests
u9e930d15f2: When this option is 0 and the test box connects to TWS earbuds, the connection between the TWS earbuds is broken by default. This setting is generally used when the MIC/speaker functions of each TWS earbud need to be tested individually.
u5a5b164e36: When set to "1" and the test box connects to TWS earbuds, the connection between the TWS earbuds is kept by default; this setting lets you test the earphone functions while the TWS earbuds are connected. (Requires support in the corresponding SDK.)
u978128748f: Putting earphones into DUT mode in UART mode
ub41b88f5b0: TWS pair DUT mode enable (对耳进入DUT模式使能)
u69195f94be: When this option is "1", it is mutually exclusive with "TWS pair test enable" (对耳测试使能), "TWS pair upgrade enable" (对耳升级使能) and "TWS pairing enable" (对耳配对使能); these options must be set to 0.
uc728d8a8e7: When set to 1, the test box periodically sends the enter-DUT command. If the target device firmware supports this command, the device enters DUT test mode when it receives the command, which speeds up searching and connection by the test instrument.
u454af28e91: When set to 0, this function is disabled.
ub1ac893922: For usage instructions, see the section "⟦1⟧Quick mass production test of TWS earphones⟦/1⟧"
u9341a0f3ab: Using the battery level threshold check for upgrades
ub547df7a30: Supports an upgrade battery level threshold check
u13adb7226e: This option supports the battery level check for UART upgrades and classic Bluetooth upgrades. The default threshold is 0 (i.e. no threshold check).
u1ede18e806: For example, if this option is set to 50% and the target device's battery level is below 50% when the upgrade starts, the error "Err: battery level below setting" (Err:电量低于设定) is reported.
u804b8bba9e: You can configure a threshold of 0-70% as needed. 100% is intended for testing the error message.
u74252ece03: Configuring the button action recognition test
ueedeb33971: Version V124f adds the button action recognition test option
u9a89d9756f: When set to "1", after the test box connects to the device under test over classic Bluetooth, it enters the button action recognition test after the frequency offset test (if enabled) and the in-ear detection test (if enabled);
ufc3fa3f78a: The tester must press or release the button as prompted on the test box screen ("Press" (按下) or "Release" (抬起));
u7c13b4fb2e: When the LCD first shows "Press" (按下), the tester must press the button under test (defined by the software of the device under test) within 8s and hold it for at least 2s. When the press is detected, the LCD shows "√". If the button is released before "Release" (抬起) is shown, the LCD shows "Error" (错误).
uf7b2783d62: Within 2s after the LCD shows "Release" (抬起), the tester must release the button. When this is detected, the LCD shows "√"; then make no new press for 2s. Perform the corresponding action again only after the LCD shows "Press" (按下) again.
u7b442d5400: Pass condition: the test passes when the "Press" (按下) and "Release" (抬起) actions have been completed twice as prompted on the LCD, and the box automatically switches to the next test item (such as the music playback test).
ue7e7972c66: Timeout definition: if there is no action within 8s after "Press" (按下) is first shown, a timeout error is reported; after the first press is recognized, each subsequent prompted action must be completed within 2s, otherwise a timeout error is also reported;
u09cb0c7e44: When set to "0", this test item is disabled. The default value is "0".
u748118dabc: Configuring in-ear detection calibration and testing
u524b094a6f: Version V1.2.4.f adds the in-ear detection calibration and test option
ued660319dc: When set to "1", after the test box connects to the device under test over classic Bluetooth, it enters in-ear detection calibration and test mode once the frequency offset test (if enabled) is complete; the tester must perform the actions prompted on the LCD screen;
u5389afff30: The LCD shows "In-ear detection trim:" (入耳检测trim:). If the calibration success command is received within 8s, "√" is shown; on failure, "Error" (错误) is shown. (Note: during calibration, keep the earphone in an insulated environment and do not touch the touch pad.)
ubaa3b40cca: The LCD shows "In-ear detection:" (入耳检测:). Within 5s, put the earphone in the ear and then keep still for 2s so that the calibration parameters can be checked. If everything is correct, "√" is shown; if "Error" (错误) is shown, there may have been a problem with the calibration, so calibrate again.
uaca5c69b29: The LCD shows "Out-of-ear detection:" (出耳检测:). Within 5s, take the earphone out of the ear and keep it out for 2s for detection, so that the calibration parameters can be checked. If everything is correct, "√" is shown; if "Error" (错误) is shown, there may have been a problem with the calibration, so calibrate again.
u83998dd095: Timeout definition: if calibration is not completed within 8s after "In-ear detection trim:" (入耳检测trim:) is first shown, a timeout error is reported; if there is no corresponding action within 5s after "In-ear detection:" (入耳检测:) or "Out-of-ear detection:" (出耳检测:) is shown, a timeout error is reported;
